<!-- pr-reviewer: 8a11b1ec1c265aea426ad35760cee86ad63d29bb -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (a `feat`, so at the next minor cut).

**What looks good**
- Mates refused by name at creation (bodies, picks, solve, non-finite nudge, "nothing would move"); interpenetration warns with part, fixture and point.
- Every locate is one undo step, going through `MoveModel` / `MoveFixture` / `AlignPartToSetup`; layering is respected (pick reader in app, UI only drives commands).
- Provenance lines on all new modules; no new dependency, `build.rs`, script or `.github` change; no snapshot PNG, golden or `CHANGELOG.md` edits.
- Decision file in `docs/decisions/561-locate-part-fixture.md`; body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #561`; conventional commit subjects.
- No `unwrap/expect/panic` in non-test added code (only inside test modules).

**Local results** (PR head trial-merged with upstream/main: already up to date, no conflicts)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --no-run` | builds |
| app `fixture_locate` | 11 passed |
| app `fixture_locate_stock` | 3 passed |
| app `fixtures` / `fixture_ux` / `fixture_mesh` / `fixture_mesh_posed` | 14 / 9 / 3 / 2 passed |
| app `setup_align` / `plane_align` | 9 / 9 passed |
| app `commands_undo` / `project_roundtrip` | 32 / 69 passed |
| app `mcp` / `mcp_setup` / `mcp_pick` | 13 / 4 / 2 passed |
| ui `--lib` (CWD `crates/ui`) | 381 passed, 1 failed, 5 ignored |
| clippy app + ui `--all-targets -D warnings` | clean |

The one ui failure is environmental on this Mac, not the PR:
```
egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds ... FAILED
egui headless run failed: No suitable graphics adapter found
```

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Questions / notes (not blocking)**
- `commands/move_model.rs` grew from 149 to 247 lines and `fixture_locate_solve.rs` is 281; all new files are under ~400.
- The unaligned multi-setup case (part moves in the other setups too, their ops go stale) is the maintainer's call per the PR body; worth a second look at the cut.
- The viewport pick flow was driven headless by the author but not hands-on in the GUI, and I did not launch the GUI.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: fde19af49e771696ef77fea47b63a8045fbca010 -->
**Needs changes before merge** (one finding; review of the delta since 8a11b1ec, merged with current main)

**What looks good**
- Keeping the mates is sound in the solver: `fixture_locate::plan` re-reads the part's current pose each time, so a re-Apply after an Offset or Turn edit moves by the remaining delta only. `locate_tests.rs` pins it: Offset Z 1 lifts to Z 1, one Ctrl+Z returns to Z 0 (the located pose, not as-modelled), a second to Z 30, Ctrl+Y redoes. One undo step per Apply.
- Arm button: after Apply the draft is still armed, so it reads "Stop locating", which matches the hint ("... or Stop locating") and the "Located." row. Consistent.
- A stale draft (deleted or renamed part or fixture) is refused by name through `plan()`: Apply greys out and the row shows "Not yet: <why>". No crash path found.
- "Located" is derived only from the `nothing would move` refusal with `half` None and mates present, so it cannot hide a real refusal.

**Local results (merged with upstream/main, trial merge clean)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `camcraft-ui --lib` (from crates/ui) | 381 passed, 1 failed, 5 ignored |
| the 6 locate tests | pass |
| app `fixture_locate` / `fixture_locate_stock` / `fixture_ux` | 11 / 3 / 9 pass |
| app `commands_undo` / `project_roundtrip` | 32 / 69 pass |
| `clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --tests -D warnings` | clean |

The one ui failure is `egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds`: "No suitable graphics adapter found" - this review machine has no GPU adapter; an environment artifact, unrelated to the PR.

**Requested before merge**
1. A kept draft now outlives its page and keeps swallowing viewport picks. Before this commit a successful Apply cleared `locate_pick` (`state_locate.rs`); now the common path leaves it set, and the only thing that clears it is the "Stop locating" button (`locate_pick.rs:134`, `locate_form.rs:38`). Every viewport route checks `state.locate_pick.is_some()` first and returns: `interact.rs:160` (`pick_face`), `interact.rs:240` (feature pick), `vertex_pick.rs:143`; `selection_feature_lines` (`interact.rs:1657`) also keeps drawing the mate faces instead of the open operation's picks. After locating a part, a user who leaves the Fixtures/Model page and picks operation geometry (Face/Vertex pick mode) gets "'X' is neither the part nor the fixture" status lines instead of their pick, with the form hidden and no hint why. Please disarm when the locate form is no longer on screen (page change away from Fixtures/Model, or the active setup changing), with a sweep at the page-change point, plus a test: locate, switch page, assert `locate_pick.is_none()` and that a face pick reaches the operation.
2. (same cause) The draft also silently persists across a setup switch and is "armed" again on return; the same sweep should fire on setup change.

**Questions / notes (not blocking)**
- Picking a fourth mate on a located three-mate draft is refused by name ("three mates fully locate the part - Remove last to change one"); correct.
- The new assertions are label-based, so no platform pixel artifact is involved.

Setting the PR back to draft with `needs-rework` until item 1 lands.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 7338fbd44486e548c4070d4261c2b5d697790fc1 -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge** (re-review at 7338fbd4; the blocker from fde19af4 is fixed).

**What looks good**
- The sweep fixes the blocker. `shell.rs:629` resets `locate_form_drawn` before the dock, `locate_form.rs:56` sets it when the form is drawn, and `locate_pick::sweep` (`locate_pick.rs:143`, called at `shell.rs:645`) drops any draft whose form was not drawn. A page left, a setup change or a closed pane all end the draft.
- After the draft is dropped, every capture site (`interact.rs:160`, `interact.rs:240`, `vertex_pick.rs:143`, and the overlay at `interact.rs:1657`) is gated on `locate_pick.is_some()`. A face pick therefore falls through to the operation instead of raising "neither the part nor the fixture".
- No arming lag and no drop on the frame the form first appears. The arm button runs before the form in the same pass (`fixture_rows.rs:65` then `:76`; `locate_form.rs` `model_row`, `arm_button` then `form`). The form therefore sets the flag in the arming frame, before the sweep runs.
- Pinned by `leaving_the_page_drops_a_located_draft`, which shows the located draft survives on the page and is dropped once the page is not drawn. I forced `sweep` to a no-op and the test failed ("off the page, the draft is dropped"). Restored afterwards.
- Setup switch: the fixture rows are drawn only for the active setup's fixtures, so the form is not drawn after a switch and the sweep drops the draft. The test covers "form not drawn", the same path. It has no dedicated setup-switch case.

**Local results (merged with fresh upstream/main, trial merge clean, no conflicts)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --no-run` | builds |
| fixture_locate | 11 passed |
| fixture_locate_stock | 3 passed |
| fixture_ux | 9 passed |
| fixtures | 14 passed |
| commands_undo | 32 passed |
| project_roundtrip | 69 passed |
| `camcraft-ui --lib` (from `crates/ui`) | 382 passed, 1 failed, 5 ignored |
| `leaving_the_page_drops_a_located_draft` | passes with the sweep, fails without it |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --tests -- -D warnings` | clean |

The one lib failure is environmental, not the PR: `egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds` fails on this machine with "No suitable graphics adapter found" (no GPU adapter in the review environment).

**Requested before merge**: none.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- Known limit, tracked as #673: a viewport click released in the very frame the page hides (layout change applied before the dock) can still reach the draft.
- A collapsed section that holds the form counts as "not drawn" and drops the draft. That seems right, since the user can't see the draft, but it is worth knowing.
- A small test for the setup-switch path would be nice to have, but it takes the same code path as the page-leave test.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: cafce25d27ef95e5f861630c0017346ea1ff1af6 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (a `feat`, so at the next minor cut). Re-review at cafce25d after the merge with main.

**What looks good**
- The earlier blocker (a kept draft outliving its page) stays fixed after the merge: the `locate_form_drawn` sweep is intact, `locate_tests::leaving_the_page_drops_a_located_draft` passes, and the conflicts with #557, #667 and the fixture library resolved without losing it.
- Every locate is one undo step through `MoveModel` / `MoveFixture` / `AlignPartToSetup`. Degenerate mates are refused by name at creation.
- No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic` in non-test added code. The matches are inside `#[cfg(test)]` (`stock_follow.rs:122` on) and the test modules.
- All new modules carry provenance lines. All new files are under 300 lines. `move_model.rs` is 247 (was 149).
- Decision file `docs/decisions/561-locate-part-fixture.md` present. Body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #561`.
- No dependency, `build.rs`, script, `.github`, golden, snapshot or `CHANGELOG.md` change.

**Local results** (PR head trial-merged with current upstream/main, clean, no conflicts)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| app `fixture_locate` / `fixture_locate_stock` | 11 / 3 pass |
| app `fixture_ux` / `fixtures` | 9 / 14 pass |
| app `commands_undo` / `project_roundtrip` / `setup_align` | 32 / 71 / 9 pass |
| app `mcp_setup` | 5 pass |
| `camcraft-ui --lib` (CWD `crates/ui`) | 429 passed, 0 failed, 5 ignored |
| clippy `camcraft-app --lib`, `camcraft-ui --tests` `-D warnings` | clean |

`cargo test -p camcraft-app --no-run` fails on main itself, not on this PR: `crates/app/tests/lathe_thread_travel.rs:83` is missing field `hand` in `OpParams::Threading` (#686). I ran the touched suites one by one instead. Clippy on app `--tests` hits the same error, so app was checked with `--lib`.
```
error[E0063]: missing field `hand` in initializer of `OpParams`
  --> crates/app/tests/lathe_thread_travel.rs:83:18
```

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- The unaligned multi-setup choice (the part also moves in other setups and their ops go stale) is the maintainer's call, as the PR body says.
- Known limit tracked as #673: a click released in the frame the page hides can still reach the draft.
- I did not launch the GUI. The viewport picks were driven headless and checked by hand by the author.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
